caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular textile design with a dark blue background and intricate light-colored patterns in a contrasting shade, possibly white or cream. The central area features a large symmetrical floral motif composed of elaborate flowers and leafy branches. Surrounding this central motif are smaller floral elements evenly distributed throughout the interior field. The composition also includes four large clusters of leaves and flowers in each corner of the main interior field. Around the central area is a border featuring repeating floral and foliate elements, interspersed with figures of birds with raised wings, each positioned in the four corners. At the bottom, in the central field, the name "Sarah Ann Grange" is woven in light-colored text. The outermost border consists of a narrow band with a continuous pattern of small floral and leaf motifs. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the design balancing dense clusters of vegetation and flowers against open areas of the blue background.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
